application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
Rear Garden
Right Hand Side Of Outbuilding/Boundary of Number 6

•	T1 - 1 x Yew to reduce in height to approximately 6 meters, to prune the inside edge away from the building and to reduce back to boundary of number 6.

Left Hand Boundary

•	T2- 1 x Magnolia to crown reduce by approximately 30% and to reshape (Reduction of approximately  1 meter) 

Rear Boundary

•	T3- 1 x Purple leaved Plum (with a fungal bracket) to remove 1 limb growing over the patio area back to upright growth and to crown reduce by approximately 30% (Reduction of approximately 0.75 meters to reduce the likelihood of failure) 
•	T4- 1 x Purple leaved Norway Maple located behind the Outbuilding to crown reduce by approximately 30%.(Reduction of approximately  1 meter)  
Clear all arisings leaving site clean and tidy.

All works are general maintenance
